<TEI xmlns='http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0'><seg xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" type="excerpt" xml:id="ex012012026-08-2801-37-57" status="unreviewed">dang po <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:unnamed_reference" ref="db:5972">kha cig</rs> <note type="gloss"><rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:3810">phyi'u</rs> dang <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:5972">zhang dbye</rs></note> na re byang chub sems dpa'i mthong lam ngo bo bzod pa dang shes pa gnyis rigs bzhi ldog pa bcu drug tu skye ba yin zhing | dang po khams gsum gyi bden pa bzhi'i chos nyid ma dag pa sngar ma mthong ba mngon sum gyis mthong ba ni bzod pa bar chad med pa'i lam yin la | ma dag pa'ang mthong spangs 
sa bon 'gag <lb edRef="inst:5894" n="132b3"/>  bzhin pa nus med dang bcas pa'o ||
de'ang 'dod pa'i khams kyi bden pa bzhi tshogs pa spyi'i chos nyid ma dag pa mthong ba'i cha nas chos shes pa'i bzod pa zhes bya ba yin cing bden pa bzhi so so la ltos nas sdug bsngal la chos shes 
pa'i bzod pa la sogs pa bzhi'o ||
de nyid gyi khams gong ma'i bden pa bzhi tshogs pa spyi'i chos nyid ma dag pa rtogs pa'i cha <lb edRef="inst:5894" n="132b4"/>  nas rjes su shes pa'i bzod pa ces [(]zhes [) ]bya ba yin cing |_so so la ltos nas sdug bsngal la rjes su shes pa'i bzod 
[630]
_pa la sogs pa bzhi yin no || de'i rjes la khams gsum gyi bden pa bzhi'i chos nyid dag pa sngar ma mthong ba mngon sum gyis mthong ba ni shes pa rnam grol gyi lam mo || de'ang 'dod pa khams kyi bden pa bzhi'i chos nyid dag pa rtogs pa'i cha nas 
chos shes <lb edRef="inst:5894" n="132b5"/> pa yin cing so so la ltos nas sdug bsngal la chos shes pa la sogs pa bzhi yin no || 
de nyid [(]kyis [) ]khams gong ma gnyis kyi chos nyid dag pa rtogs pa'i cha nas rjes su shes pa zhes bya la|_bden pa bzhi so so la ltos nas sdug bsngal la rjes su shes pa la sogs pa bzhi yin no zhes gsungs so ||</seg></TEI>
